description: This file contains source code for the BORIS (Behavioral Observation Research Interactive Software) project, focusing on importing, exporting, and managing behaviors, ethograms, subjects, and variables within the GUI. It includes functions for exporting data in various formats, importing from files and clipboard, and handling project-related data structures, specifically tailored to the project structure and configuration. It employs PySide6 for GUI interactions, pandas for data handling, and json for data serialization.
